confidence_notes: Restaurant and hostel anchors rest on several aggregated sources (citycost, whereandwhen, ExpatExchange, Budget Your Trip) that are mostly undated, so July 2026 timing is approximate. Hotel 3-star is the least certain: averages of about $27 to $30 conflict with sample listings of $45 to $55. Cocktail and wine_glass have no direct source; they are set from a beer-relative judgement (about 3.2x and 4x the beer anchor), not observed prices. Beer and coffee are set slightly above the aggregated street-level figures to reflect restaurant service.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are based on Siem Reap-specific aggregated sources. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer anchor.
